name: Taking Care Of The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that God created mankind in His image and entrusted them with dominion over all living creatures and the earth, commissioning them to multiply, replenish, and subdue it (Genesis 1:26, 1:28). This responsibility includes actively tending and preserving the land, as shown by God's placement of Adam in the Garden of Eden to dress and keep it (Genesis 2:15). The land ultimately belongs to God, reminding us that we are stewards and sojourners upon it (Leviticus 25:23), and we are warned against defiling it, as pollution and bloodshed bring lasting defilement (Numbers 35:33). Even creation itself, including beasts and birds, testifies to God's wisdom and care (Job 12:7), encouraging us to learn from His handiwork in our stewardship.
